utterances.speaker: JUDGE GUNEY
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Good day to everyone. The hearing on appeal is now open. Mr. Registrar, could you please call the case number.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Thank you. And good afternoon, Your Honour. This is case number IT-98-32/1-A, The Prosecutor versus Milan Lukic and Sredoje Lukic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE GUNEY
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you. Mr. Milan Lukic, are you able to follow the proceedings in a language that you understand? THE APPELLANT M. LUKIC: [Interpretation] Yes, I can, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE GUNEY
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you. Mr. Sredoje Lukic, can you hear and follow the proceedings in a language that you understand? THE APPELLANT S. LUKIC: [Interpretation] Yes, I can, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE GUNEY
utterances.text: [Interpretation] That's perfect. Please sit down. I would now like to have the introductions for the parties or the presentations for the parties. Could we start with the Prosecution, please.

utterances.speaker: MS. MONCHY
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Good afternoon, Your Honours. Virginie Monchy and Kyle Wood for the Prosecution, with Mr. Colin Nawrot our assistant.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE GUNEY
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you. I'm now addressing Mr. Milan Lukic's Defence team.

utterances.speaker: MR. VISNJIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Good day, Your Honour. On behalf of Milan Lukic, Tomislav Visnjic and Dragan Ivetic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE GUNEY
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you. I now, turn to the representatives of Mr. Sredoje Lukic's Defence team.

utterances.speaker: MR. CEPIC
utterances.text: Good afternoon, Your Honour. On behalf of the Sredoje Lukic Defence team, myself, Djuro Cepic is with counsel on my left hand-hand side, Mr. Jens Dieckmann as co-counsel, and on my right-hand side, Mr. Mile Mitrovic as our assistant. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE GUNEY
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you. I would like to inform you that this Status Conference has been convened pursuant Rule 65 bis (B) and (C) of the Rules of Procedure, according to which a Status Conference shall be convened within 120 days of the filing of a Notice of Appeal, and, thereafter, within 120 days after the last Status Conference. The main objective of a Status Conference is to allow any person in custody, pending appeal, the opportunity to raise issues in relation thereto, including the mental and physical condition of that person. This is the ninth Status Conference within the framework of the appeal proceedings. The last Status Conference took place on the 24th of May, 2012. The parties have agreed to have this Status Conference held after the 120-day-time limit. This is due to counsels' availability. We intend to file the appeal Judgement before the winter recess in 2012. Unfortunately, it is not possible for me to provide anymore precise information. I'd now like to address Mr. Milan Lukic and Sredoje Lukic in order to ask them about the conditions in the Detention Unit and about their health. First of all, I would like to address Mr. Milan Lukic. Are there any issues you would like to raise that concern the conditions in the Detention Unit or that concern your health. THE APPELLANT M. LUKIC: [Interpretation] As far as my health -- as I'm concerned, Your Honour, I have a heavy cold, a flu today, and out of respect to you, I came to attend this Status Conference. As for the detention conditions in the Detention Unit, during the past seven years of my stay there I have never had any problem, either from guards or the management of the Detention Unit or anyone else. Likewise, I myself never caused any problems. I wasn't responsible for any violation. I have no complaints concerning the conditions of my detention. That's all I have to say.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE GUNEY
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you very much. You may sit down. I have taken note of your concerns, and pursuant to Rule 81 on the conditions in the Detention Unit, you can file a request with the commander or complaint at any point in time, and, if necessary, you can file such a complaint with the Registrar. Thank you yet again. And I'm now addressing Mr. Sredoje Lukic. Mr., Lukic, are there any issues you would like to raise that concern the conditions in the Detention Unit or that concern your health? You have the floor. THE APPELLANT S. LUKIC: [Interpretation] Thank you, Your Honour, for giving me the floor. And the conditions are regular, as they have been so far. I have nothing else to add.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE GUNEY
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you very much. You may sit down. I am happy to hear that everything is fine, as was previously the case, too. Finally, I would like to ask the parties if there are any issues they would like to raise at this Status Conference. First of all, I'm turning to the representative of the Prosecution. You have the floor.

utterances.speaker: MS. MONCHY
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you, Mr. President. For the moment, we have no issues to raise.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE GUNEY
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you. I have taken note of what you have said. Do Mr. Milan Lukic's Defence counsel have any issues they would like to raise?

utterances.speaker: MR. VISNJIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you, Your Honour. We have nothing to raise.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE GUNEY
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you. I'm now turning to the representatives of Mr. Sredoje Lukic's Defence team. Are there any issues you would like to raise at this point in time?

utterances.speaker: MR. CEPIC
utterances.text: Thank you, Your Honour. Nothing to raise at this moment.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE GUNEY
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you very much. As far as I am concerned, I have no other issues to raise, and, therefore, I believe that we can close today's hearing. I would like to thank the parties for their participation and the Tribunal's personnel for their assistance in organising this Status Conference. The hearing is adjourned.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE GUNEY
utterances.text: at 3.42 p.m.
